channel.title: FrameShot blog
channel.description: Guides for screenshots and screen recording in Chrome.

item.title: How to Screenshot in Chrome on Windows, Mac and Chromebook
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: How to screenshot in Chrome on Windows, Mac, ChromeOS and Linux: keyboard shortcuts, the hidden DevTools commands, and full-page, area and element captures.

item.title: How to Screenshot on a Chromebook: Shortcuts and Tools
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: How to screenshot on a Chromebook with keyboard shortcuts, the Screen capture tool or tablet buttons, where files are saved, and how to capture a full page.

item.title: How to Screen Record on Windows 11 (4 Simple Ways)
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: How to screen record on Windows 11 with Snipping Tool, Xbox Game Bar, PowerPoint or a Chrome extension, with sound, mic and webcam, and which to pick.

item.title: How to Screen Record on a Mac With Sound
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: How to screen record on Mac with sound: record your voice with Cmd+Shift+5 or QuickTime, and a Chrome tab’s or your Mac’s own audio with an extension.

item.title: How to Take a Scrolling Screenshot on Windows and Mac
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: A scrolling screenshot captures more than fits on screen. Why Windows and Mac lack one, and how to capture long pages, chats and scrolling panels in Chrome.

item.title: How to Screenshot Part of a Web Page in Chrome
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Screenshot part of a web page or capture a single element in Chrome: system snipping tools, DevTools commands and an extension that scrolls past the screen.

item.title: How to Annotate a Screenshot: Arrows, Text and Steps
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: How to annotate a screenshot so it’s clear at a glance: which tools to use, simple design rules, and worked examples for bug reports, tutorials and feedback.

item.title: How to Save a Web Page as a PDF or Image in Chrome
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Save a web page as a PDF with Chrome’s print dialog, or as a PDF or image that looks exactly like the screen. Which to pick, plus PNG, JPEG and WebP compared.

item.title: How to Record Your Screen and Webcam for a Tutorial
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Record screen and webcam for a tutorial video: plan a short script, set up your mic and camera, choose what to share, record in Chrome and export MP4.

item.title: Screen Recorder Extensions for Chrome: What to Check
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: What to check in a screen recorder extension for Chrome before you install: watermarks, time limits, uploads, permissions, sound, formats and privacy.

item.title: Private by Design: Why FrameShot Keeps Your Files Local
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: How FrameShot captures and records without uploads or accounts, what each permission is for, what it sends, and how to check it yourself in a minute.

item.title: How to Take a Full-Page Screenshot in Chrome (3 Easy Ways)
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Capture an entire web page in Chrome with an extension, the built-in DevTools command or Print to PDF, plus tips for sticky headers and very long pages.

item.title: How to Record Your Screen With Audio in Chrome
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Record a tab, a window or your whole screen with sound, your microphone and a webcam bubble. What to tick in Chrome’s dialog, and how to fix a silent video.

item.title: How to Blur or Redact Sensitive Information in Screenshots
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Why blur and pixelation can sometimes be undone, when to use a solid redaction box, and a checklist of details to hide before you share a screenshot.

item.title: How to Turn a Screen Recording Into a GIF
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: Make small, sharp GIFs from screen recordings: when a GIF beats a video, which size and frame rate to choose, and how to keep the file light.

item.title: Better Bug Reports With Screenshots and Short Videos
item.dc:creator: Shahriar Ahmed
item.description: A practical template for bug reports developers can act on: what to capture, how to annotate it, and when a short screen recording beats a paragraph.
